name: ch.prospex/swissco
title: Swiss company data
description: Swiss company data: Zefix register, SHAB gazette, simap tenders, FINMA, GLEIF and ARAMIS

environmentVariables.name: ZEFIX_USER
environmentVariables.description: Zefix PublicREST username, issued by zefix@bj.admin.ch. Optional: every tool works without it.

environmentVariables.name: SWISSCO_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Where gazette bodies and the two FINMA files are cached. Defaults to ~/.swissco.

environmentVariables.name: SWISSCO_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between requests. Raises the floor of 0.5s and cannot lower it.
